statement: On every /m/* route the top-left back control opens the Stack, a sheet with four bands: Now (the armed block: title, state, elapsed), Earlier today (blocks in reverse order, each resumable in place), Queues (Tasks, Work orders, Picker queue, To-ship, each opening as the existing table), Find (the launch index search). Long-press on back jumps to any block. A pure stackModel builds the bands; elapsed is the sum of intervals, never wall time. The drawer's page tree is removed; its leaves stay reachable from Find and by scanning.
